title: Evolution Part Two: Adaptation Rate and the Red Queen Effect
coreMove: Measure adaptation against a moving baseline, not against your own prior version.
sourcePressure: Adaptation Rate and the Red Queen Effect concern changing quickly enough while the landscape and competitors also move.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: turning the Red Queen effect into generic run-faster urgency
